summary:
Reusable findings from designing and reviewing the board-currency rules (design docs/coordination/2026-10-31-board-currency-gate.md). Each is pinned by a test or a mutation control in tests/board-currency/.

1. Attribution must be structural. A Refs-only routine route that never names the Delivery leaves merged work unattributable on the board; requiring exactly one Project 3 Delivery with a parent Outcome (R1) fixes it at the merge path rather than by reminders. A PR reference is never a Delivery.
2. All children closed is not done. An Outcome whose sub-issues are all closed is a finding (R5) whose resolution is Root's: propose closure or file the remaining Deliveries. See github/project-auto-add-conflicts-with-reader-row-cap for why new sub-issues are linked before they are enrolled.
3. Every rule needs an Unknown leg. Truncated native connections (sub-issues, blocked-by, project items), unread or truncated comments, and an unreadable card with no identity (which could be any lookup miss) must yield Unknown, not a verdict.
4. Normalise once. The override marker is matched on one shared normalised text (CRLF to LF, code spans and fences removed) used by both the matcher and the fetch's selection of PRs whose editor must be read; two normalisations silently dropped CRLF overrides in review.
5. Public reports cannot carry private state. Findings in a public issue name only explicitly public subjects; carried state (unlinked merged PRs) is re-derived from native searches each run, chunked by day under the search cap, rather than stored in the public marker.
6. Bound the noise. A deterministic rule that fires on every merge (R1) belongs in the report body; notifications are reserved for drift changes and new non-R1 findings.
7. Fixtures must not read the wall clock: a drift selftest that analysed a frozen-clock fixture at now() turned red a day after it landed.

Limits: lessons, not current state or authority; parameters and rule versions are in the cited source and change by version bump.
title: Lessons from making board currency deterministic
